accepted.summary: No specific numeric volume given; general prohibition on contacting workers via drift.
accepted.quote: Do not apply this product in a way that will contact workers or other persons, either directly or through drift.

accepted.summary: Only protected handlers may be in the area during application.
accepted.quote: Only protected handlers may be in the area during application.

accepted.summary: Do not enter or allow worker entry into treated areas during the REI of 48 hours.
accepted.quote: Do not enter or allow worker entry into treated areas during the Restricted-Entry Interval (REI) of 48 hours.

accepted.summary: The REI is 72 hours in areas where average rainfall is less than 25 inches per year.
accepted.quote: The REI is 72 hours in areas where average rainfall is less than 25 inches per year.

accepted.summary: PPE required for early entry involving contact with treated material includes coveralls, waterproof gloves, chemical-resistant footwear plus socks, protective eyewear, and chemical-resistant headgear for overhead exposure.
accepted.quote: PPE required for early entry to treated areas that is permitted under the Worker Protection Standard and that involves contact with anything that has been treated, such as plants, soil, or water, is: x Coveralls over long-sleeved shirt and long pants x Waterproof gloves x Chemical-resistant footwear plus socks x Protective eyewear x Chemical-resistant headgear for overhead exposure

accepted.summary: Chemical-resistant apron required when cleaning equipment, mixing or loading.
accepted.quote: x Chemical-resistant apron when cleaning equipment, mixing or loading

accepted.summary: Chemical-resistant headgear required for overhead exposure.
accepted.quote: x Chemical-resistant headgear for overhead exposure

accepted.summary: Applicators and other handlers must wear coveralls over long-sleeved shirt and long pants, waterproof gloves, chemical-resistant footwear plus socks, protective eyewear.
accepted.quote: Applicators and other handlers must wear: x Coveralls over long-sleeved shirt and long pants x Waterproof gloves x Chemical-resistant footwear plus socks x Protective eyewear

accepted.summary: Remove PPE immediately after handling; wash thoroughly and change into clean clothing as soon as possible.
accepted.quote: Remove PPE immediately after handling this product. As soon as possible, wash thoroughly and change into clean clothing.

accepted.summary: Wash the outside of gloves before removing.
accepted.quote: Wash the outside of gloves before removing.

accepted.summary: Wash hands with plenty of soap and water before eating, drinking, chewing gum, using tobacco or using the toilet.
accepted.quote: Wash hands with plenty of soap and water before eating, drinking, chewing gum, using tobacco or using the toilet.

accepted.summary: Remove clothing/PPE immediately if pesticide gets inside; then wash thoroughly and put on clean clothing.
accepted.quote: Remove clothing/PPE immediately if pesticide gets inside. Then wash thoroughly and put on clean clothing.

accepted.summary: Keep and wash PPE separately from other laundry.
accepted.quote: Keep and wash PPE separately from other laundry.

accepted.summary: Discard clothing and other absorbent materials that have been drenched or heavily contaminated with this product’s concentrate. Do not reuse them.
accepted.quote: Discard clothing and other absorbent materials that have been drenched or heavily contaminated with this product’s concentrate. Do not reuse them.

accepted.summary: If no wash instructions exist for washable PPE, use detergent and hot water.
accepted.quote: If no such instructions for washables exist, use detergent and hot water.

accepted.summary: Follow manufacturer's instructions for cleaning/maintaining PPE.
accepted.quote: Follow manufacturer's instructions for cleaning/maintaining PPE.

accepted.summary: Do not apply in a manner that will contact workers via drift (implies wind/drift management).
accepted.quote: Do not apply this product in a way that will contact workers or other persons, either directly or through drift.

accepted.summary: Do not apply directly to water, or to areas where surface water is present or to intertidal areas below the mean high water mark.
accepted.quote: Do not apply directly to water, or to areas where surface water is present or to intertidal areas below the mean high water mark.

accepted.summary: Do not contaminate water when disposing of equipment washwaters.
accepted.quote: Do not contaminate water when disposing of equipment washwaters.

accepted.summary: Do not contaminate water used for irrigation or domestic purposes.
accepted.quote: Do not contaminate water used for irrigation or domestic purposes.

accepted.summary: Protect the forage and habitat of non-target organisms by following label directions intended to minimize spray drift.
accepted.quote: Protect the forage and habitat of non-target organisms by following label directions intended to minimize spray drift.

accepted.summary: Release height cannot exceed 10 ft above vegetative canopy unless greater height is necessary for pilot safety.
accepted.quote: Do not release spray at a height greater than 10 feet above the vegetative canopy, unless a greater application height is necessary for pilot safety.

accepted.summary: Use a fine to medium or coarser droplet size (ASABE S572.I).
accepted.quote: For all applications, applicators are required to use a fine to medium or coarser droplet size (ASABE S572.I).

accepted.summary: Nozzle height must not exceed 3 feet above ground or crop canopy.
accepted.quote: Apply with the nozzle height recommended by the manufacturer, but no more than 3 feet above the ground or crop canopy.

accepted.summary: Wind speed must not exceed 10 mph at application site.
accepted.quote: Do not apply when wind speeds exceed 10 miles per hour at the application site.

accepted.summary: Application prohibited during temperature inversions.
accepted.quote: Do not apply during temperature inversions.

accepted.summary: Boom length must not exceed 65% of wingspan for airplanes.
accepted.quote: The boom length must not exceed 65% of the wingspan for airplanes or 75% of the rotor blade diameter for helicopters.

accepted.summary: Boom length must not exceed 75% of rotor blade diameter for helicopters.
accepted.quote: The boom length must not exceed 65% of the wingspan for airplanes or 75% of the rotor blade diameter for helicopters.

accepted.summary: Use ½ swath displacement upwind at the downwind edge of the field.
accepted.quote: Applicators must use ½ swath displacement upwind at the downwind edge of the field.

accepted.summary: Increase spray volume to produce larger droplets; use highest practical spray volume.
accepted.quote: Volume - Increasing the spray volume so that larger droplets are produced will reduce spray drift. Use the highest practical spray volume for the application. lf a greater spray volume is needed, consider using a nozzle with a higher flow rate.

accepted.summary: Consider using a nozzle with a higher flow rate if greater spray volume is needed.
accepted.quote: Volume - Increasing the spray volume so that larger droplets are produced will reduce spray drift. Use the highest practical spray volume for the application. lf a greater spray volume is needed, consider using a nozzle with a higher flow rate.

accepted.summary: Use the lowest spray pressure recommended for the nozzle to produce target spray volume and droplet size.
accepted.quote: Pressure - Use the lowest spray pressure recommended for the nozzle to produce the target spray volume and droplet size.

accepted.summary: Use a spray nozzle designed for the intended application; consider using nozzles designed to reduce drift.
accepted.quote: Spray Nozzle - Use a spray nozzle that is designed for the intended application. Consider using nozzles designed to reduce drift.

accepted.summary: Follow nozzle manufacturers' recommendations for setting up nozzles; orient nozzles parallel with airflow in flight to reduce fine droplets.
accepted.quote: Adjust Nozzles - Follow nozzle manufacturers recommendations for setting up nozzles. Generally, to reduce fine droplets , nozzles should be oriented parallel with the airflow in flight.

accepted.summary: Prohibits applying via irrigation systems.
accepted.quote: Do not apply this product through any type of irrigation system.

accepted.unit: lb ethephon AI per acre per year
accepted.summary: Limits annual application to 2.0 lb ethephon AI per acre.
accepted.quote: Do not apply more than 2.0 lb ethephon AI per acre per year.

accepted.summary: Prohibits application if rain is expected within 6 hours due to potential performance reduction.
accepted.quote: Do not apply this product if rain is expected within 6 hours as product performance may be reduced.

accepted.summary: Prohibits planting rotation crops within 30 days after application unless used as cover crops only (no harvest for food/feed).
accepted.quote: Rotation Crop Restrictions: Do not plant back another crop within 30 days after application.

accepted.summary: Recommends using a defoliant before application to improve coverage on rank or lodged cotton.
accepted.quote: It is recommended that an application of a defoliant be made BEFORE an [Ethephon E-AG 6 Plant Growth Regulator] application to facilitate boll and foliage coverage by this product.

accepted.summary: product may be applied as a tank mixture or in sequence with specified products
accepted.quote: [Ethephon E-AG 6 Plant Growth Regulator] may be applied as a tank mixture or in sequence with the following products: Def ®, Folex®, Dropp®, Dropp® Ultra, Ginstar®, Harvade®, Methyl Parathion, Guthion®, and Malathion®.

accepted.summary: use caution when tank mixed with defoliants due to possible slight reduction in boll opening
accepted.quote: Use caution when this product is applied as a tank mix with defoliants as a slight reduction in boll opening could occur.

accepted.summary: only apply as tank mix with desiccants if plant desiccation is required
accepted.quote: Only apply this product as a tank mix with desiccants if plant desiccation is required.

accepted.summary: do not use defoliant unless sufficient mature unopened bolls are present to produce desired yield
accepted.quote: Do not use a defoliant unless sufficient mature unopened bolls are present to produce the desired yield.

accepted.summary: do not tank mix with desiccants if cotton is to be spindle harvested
accepted.quote: DO NOT TANK MIX THIS PRODUCT WITH DESICCANTS IF COTTON IS TO BE SPINDLE HARVESTED.

accepted.summary: do not tank mix with desiccants containing sodium chlorate under certain conditions due to risk of toxic chloride fumes
accepted.quote: UNDER CERTAIN CONDITIONS, TANK MIXTURES OF [Ethepho n E-AG 6 Plant Growth Regulator] WITH DESICCANTS CONTAINING SODIUM CHLORATE COULD RESULT IN THE FORMATION OF HYPOCHLOROUS ACIDS WHICH ON HEATING WILL EMIT TOXIC CHLORIDE FUMES.

accepted.summary: do not mix with ammonium thiosulfate as mixtures may result in formation of toxic fumes
accepted.quote: DO NOT MIX THIS PRODUCT WITH AMMONIUM THIOSULFATE AS THESE MIXTURES MAY RESULT IN FORMATION OF TOXIC FUMES.
